items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: From the office, Christian was down in the office, down to the booking office I was in, and Moe Gale was there to overlook everything that was being carried on for me.

ctx.x: So, I've been fortunate enough in that part not to be in too much of that kind of dirty dealing and all that. From the office, Christian was down in the office, down to the booking office I was in, and Moe Gale was there to overlook everything that was being carried on for me.

So, we was something like, well, just like I said like partners, like at Christmas, the band, the fellows there, every Christmas I had a nice bonus for them for Christmas. You know, things like that made them like a family.
